comment: The table of the typed family of the tests: the three tables of
test/fort/support/generator.ft and the judgement of test/fort/support/judgement.ft. The
first 6 rows each take one row out of TYPES, STORAGES or OPERATIONS: a type with no text is
no type, a storage class with no place is no storage class, and an operation with no text is
no operation, so the mutant compiles and the family loses the cells or the statements of
that row. Two rows stand for each table, the first row and another one.
test/fort/owner/typed/count_test.ft prints the count of the cells, the vocabulary size of
each cell, the count of the cells of each operation and the count of the functions of 0 to
3 operations; a row is caught when a line changes. Each row `judgement-*` changes one
rule of the judgement: which verdicts it judges, what the gate of
test/fort/support/disposition.ft decides, which events are errors and which rule
takes an event, the line that a report line names, the `dead` markers of an abort, the
release-only bit of a drop, the verdict `reported`, the inputs of a run, the end of a run,
each kind of error of a failure, the class of a failure, the statements that vacate a
place and the events that end its vacated state, and the exit status.
test/fort/owner/typed/judgement_test.ft prints each of those
rules over tables and over a batch of functions that it writes. The sources are support
modules of the tests, so
the build only joins them into build/typed_support.txt, and the md5 guard reads that file.
The stage does not run the 8 parts of the family. The table runs in the Linux VM with the
debug preset after `tools/vm build`.

stages.name: the count test and the judgement test of the typed family
stages.command: python3 test/lang/run_tests.py --root test/fort --fort build/Linux/debug/fort --std-dir build/Linux/debug/std -j 2 owner/typed/count_test owner/typed/judgement_test

mutations.what: the type table loses its first row, the owning pointer
the type table loses the nested aggregate
the storage table loses its first row, the local
the storage table loses the global
the operation table loses its first row, the store of a fresh value
the operation table loses the move through a cast

mutations.new: bool error = is_trusted(kind) || disposition.is_error(ev, at_abort || leak);
mutations.what: each leak is excused, also one that stands at no abort
an event of a kind that the gate of disposition.ft trusts is no error

mutations.new: bool error = is_trusted(kind) || at_exit || disposition.is_error(ev, at_abort);
mutations.what: a `leak at exit` of a cycle of owners is an error
no event goes through the gate of disposition.ft, so a leak at an abort is an error
only a use after release and a use after move are errors
no `dead` marker moves to its own line, so no leak stands at an abort
each `dead` marker counts as one of an abort

mutations.old: ruling said = rule(ev, at_abort(bt->aborts[..bt->deads], ev->at.line), reports,
mutations.new:
bool ended = run->end.kind == interpreter.outcome_kind.oc_abort;
        ruling said = rule(ev, ended || at_abort(bt->aborts[..bt->deads], ev->at.line), reports,
mutations.what: each leak of a run that ends in an abort has the excuse, also one on a statement
a `del(s, d)` whose drop is not release-only rejects no function

mutations.old: bool judged = it->said == verdict.vd_accepted || it->said == verdict.vd_reported;
mutations.what: the judgement skips each function with a report line
a line of `--leak-report` takes an event of each kind
a line of `--span-del-report` takes an event of each kind on its line
a report line takes an event of its option on each line of the batch

mutations.old: for (u64 mut k = 0; str.ends_with(file, "main.ft") && k < named.len; k++) {
mutations.new: for (u64 mut k = 0; k < named.len; k++) {
mutations.what: a report line takes an event on its line in another file
a line of one report option names its line for the other option too
a report line of another file names a line of the entry module
a report line names the line of the first `dead` marker after relocate
a line of `--leak-report` or `--whole-store-report` gives no verdict `reported`
a line of `--span-del-report` gives no verdict `reported`

mutations.old: for (u64 mut input = 0; said != verdict.vd_refused && input < 8; input++) {
mutations.new: for (u64 mut input = 0; said != verdict.vd_refused && input < 4; input++) {
mutations.what: no run has the input `live`
a run that ends in `invalid access` with no error event is no failure
a failure keeps the kind of its first error only
the class `moved` takes each use after move, also one of a local owner
the class `moved` takes a use after a statement that vacates the whole place
`else` is no row of VACATES
`self` vacates the place in a storage class whose call does not move it
a `defer` before the error vacates the place at once, with no loop

mutations.old: } else if (!direct && is_turned(f, before ? k : f->pos)) {
mutations.new: } else if (false && is_turned(f, before ? k : f->pos)) {
mutations.what: no statement vacates the place in a later turn of a loop

mutations.old: } else if (!direct && is_turned(f, before ? k : f->pos)) {
mutations.what: a `defer` before a loop runs its drop in each turn of that loop
a store into the place after the statement that vacates it ends no vacated state
a store before the statement that vacates the place ends the vacated state

mutations.old: } else if (!direct && is_turned(f, before ? k : f->pos)) {
mutations.new: } else if (!direct && !is_filled(f, 0, f->pos) && is_turned(f, before ? k : f->pos)) {
mutations.what: a store before the error ends the vacated state of a later turn of a loop
`swap` is no row of FILLS
the test of `choose load` against `null` ends no vacated state
the test of `choose load` ends the vacated state in a type whose test compares no pointer with `null`
each statement of a type with a pointer test ends the vacated state
the class `span pointer` takes a use through the pointer in a function with no `del(s, d)` of the span
the class `range callback` takes a storage class that the callback does not reach
the class `range callback` takes an `extern call` before the range loop
the class `view` takes a load in a function that gives the view no pointer
the class `moved value` takes each use after move
the class `moved value` takes a use after a statement that vacates the whole place

mutations.old: bool stored = holds_before(f, pos, "move in") || holds_before(f, pos, "choose")
mutations.new: bool stored = is_filled(f, 0, pos) || holds_before(f, pos, "choose")
mutations.what: the class `moved value` takes a store of a value that is no `move(y)`
a failure with no class gives the exit status 0
